after.name: Lorekeeper_Gundlt
after.lua_content:
-- Reviewed 2026-10-22: P99 NPC presence, ProjectEQ flavor provenance.
-- Source: sources/projecteq/thurgadina/Lorekeeper_Gundlt.pl
-- No new faction, class, level or epic gates; no rewards invented.

function event_say(e)
    if e.message:findi("hail") then
        e.self:Say("Ahem....yes, hail. I suppose that would suffice in this case. Well, then, hail to you, sir. I am Lorekeeper Gundlt, master keeper of etiquette. It is my duty, as ordained by the Grand Historian, to keep all records and rules on all royal audiences and dealings.")
    end
    if e.message:findi("royal") then
        e.self:Say("Why, Frostreaver IV, of course! All who wish an audience must first consult with me to be educated on the proper way to address our great Dain. Do you wish an audience with the crown?")
    end
    if e.message:findi("crown") then
        e.self:Say("Very well, then. When you approach our king you must keep your head bowed and eyes focused approximately 5 to 6 feet in front of you. When you first see the boots of our Lord you must kneel before him and touch your forehead to your knee. At this point you may rise and address the king. He will not respond to the popular and mundane \"Hail.\" You must say, 'Greetings and good fortune to you, honored Dain Frostreaver IV.' Remember to mind your manners when in the presence of the Dain for his guards are fiercely protective of him.")
    end
end

    end
    if e.message:findi("door") then
        e.self:Say("Why this door behind me which I stand in front of course. You didn't by chance fall on the ice and hit your head I hope good " .. e.other:GetRaceName() .. ". By order of the Dain, none are permitted to see or go beyond this entrance.")

    if e.message:findi("beyond this entrance") then
        e.self:Say("Why beyond this door lies the most wonderous. . . oh wait, I can't tell you that " .. e.other:GetRaceName() .. ". All I can tell you is that the door has also been magically sealed by our Grand Historian. Please move along now and enjoy the rest of the Keep.")

after.name: Lady_Gelistial
after.lua_content:
-- P99 Crest page also verifies the fourth Lithiniath branch; dynamic player name replaces transcript Pharos.
-- Reviewed 2026-10-22: P99 NPC presence, ProjectEQ flavor provenance.
-- Source: sources/projecteq/wakening/Lady_Gelistial.pl
-- No new faction, class, level or epic gates; no rewards invented.

function event_say(e)
    if e.message:findi("hail") then
        e.self:Emote("Lady Gelistial nods towards " .. e.other:GetCleanName() .. " and a soft gentle voice whispers in your mind as if carried by the breeze passing through the gentle grove. You tread upon the sacred ground of Tunare. I am the Lady Gelistial, baroness of the Tunarean Unicorns. Are you a [friend] of the Tunarean Court?")
    end
    if e.message:findi("friend") then
        e.self:Say("Be wary of the black unicorns then my friend. All unicorns once inspired dreams and fascination in mortals but the lineage of Lithiniath has been twisted and now inspire delusions and madness. If my duties here were not so pressing I would seek the wisdom of [Prince Thirneg] in finding a cure for the cursed bloodline of Lithiniath.")
    end
    if e.message:findi("Prince Thirneg") then
        e.self:Say("Prince Thirneg is the ruler of the Tunarean Court. He resides in the Plane of Growth where he is constant contact with the all mother herself.")
    end
    if e.message:findi("lithiniath") then
        e.self:Say("Lithiniath was once a proud and noble Unicorn until he stumbled upon the realm of Fizzlethorpe Bristlebane. The lord of mischief twisted the magical nature of Lithiniath. The once noble unicorns fur grew blacker as delusions clouded his mind and madness follows where he treads.")
    end
end

    item_lib.return_items(e.self, e.other, e.trade)
